key.name: enabled
key.description: Make the screen warmer at night.

key.name: mode
key.description: "automatic" follows sunset and sunrise at the current location, "schedule" uses schedule-from and schedule-to, and "always" keeps the night temperature all the time. Without a location, "automatic" falls back to the schedule.

key.name: night-temperature
key.description: Color temperature of the screen at night, in Kelvin. 6500 is neutral.

key.name: day-temperature
key.description: Color temperature of the screen during the day, in Kelvin. At 6500 (neutral) the screen is left alone during the day.

key.name: schedule-from
key.description: Hour of the day (for example 20.5 for 20:30) when the change to the night temperature starts in "schedule" mode.

key.name: schedule-to
key.description: Hour of the day when the change back to the day temperature starts in "schedule" mode.

key.name: transition-duration
key.description: Minutes the change between day and night takes in "schedule" mode. In "automatic" mode the change follows twilight: it lasts from sunset to the end of civil dusk, and from civil dawn to sunrise.

key.name: smooth-transitions
key.description: Fade to a new temperature over a couple of seconds when Night Light is turned on or off or its settings change, instead of switching at once.

key.name: preserve-calibration
key.description: On X11, apply Night Light on top of the gamma ramps the outputs already have (calibration loaded by colord, xcalib or dispwin) instead of replacing them.

key.name: location-source
key.summary: Where to get the location from
key.description: "clock" uses the home location of the MATE clock applet, "geoclue" asks GeoClue, "timezone" uses the coordinates of the system timezone, and "manual" uses manual-latitude and manual-longitude. "auto" tries the clock applet, then GeoClue, then the timezone.

key.name: manual-latitude
key.description: Latitude in degrees, north positive, used when location-source is "manual".

key.name: manual-longitude
key.description: Longitude in degrees, east positive, used when location-source is "manual".

key.name: last-coordinates
key.description: Latitude and longitude last found by an automatic source; used until a source answers. (91, 181) means none.
